title: AI CoWorkers: digital coworkers for your team | utxo AG
description: AI CoWorkers join your team as digital coworkers: with a role, tasks in the channel your team already uses, questions when needed and results for review.
tagline: AI CoWorkers as digital coworkers in your team
lede: An AI CoWorker is a member of your team, with a name, a role and tasks. It works in the channel your team already uses, asks when something is unclear and submits results for review.

faq.q: How does a CoWorker differ from a chatbot or a copilot?
faq.a: A chatbot answers questions, a copilot supports one person inside their application. A CoWorker has a role in the team: it takes on tasks from start to finish, works in your systems, asks when information is missing and submits the result for review.

faq.q: Does a CoWorker make decisions on its own?
faq.a: It works through tasks independently and does not decide anything in your place. You define which steps require approval. Where it matters, a human approves.

faq.q: Which channels and systems does a CoWorker work in?
faq.a: In the ones your team already uses: team chat, email or a ticket system for collaboration, plus the systems it needs for its tasks, such as file storage, CRM or ERP. We clarify which integrations make sense for each project.

faq.q: How long does it take until a CoWorker works in the team?
faq.a: That depends on the role and the integrations. Some CoWorkers are productive within a few weeks, others take months. We assess your case in the first conversation.

Data is processed only on your instructions, and there is no training with your data. We create the DPA individually for each project. Hosting tailored to your requirements: Germany, EU or on-premises. We work model-agnostic and assess local open-source models per project.

faq.q: Can a team have several CoWorkers?
faq.a: Yes. Each CoWorker has its own role, its own access rights and a person it reports to. We recommend starting with one role and expanding once the collaboration runs smoothly.

scope.title: A team member with a clear remit.
scope.text: We develop the CoWorker for a specific role in your team. The role profile defines what it takes on, what it works with and who it reports to.

points.name: Role and remit
points.text: A CoWorker with a name, clearly defined tasks and a person in the team it reports to.

points.name: Your team's knowledge
points.text: It works with your templates, guidelines and previous results and knows the status of every open task.

points.name: Access to your systems
points.text: It reads and writes only where you allow it, for example in file storage, CRM or ERP.

points.name: Questions and review
points.text: When information is missing, it asks. It submits results for review before they leave the team.

points.name: Development and operations
points.text: utxo AG develops, hosts and monitors the CoWorker and extends the role together with your team.

points.name: Channels
points.text: Team chat, email or ticket system: the CoWorker works in the channels your team already uses.

points.name: Systems
points.text: Integration with ERP, CRM, DMS and file storage via interfaces, with its own narrowly defined rights.

points.name: Approvals
points.text: You define which steps require approval, such as sending to customers or posting a booking.

points.name: Log
points.text: Every action is logged. Your team sees what the CoWorker did, with which sources and for whom.

points.name: Operations
points.text: utxo AG hosts and monitors the CoWorker. Hosting tailored to your requirements: Germany, EU or on-premises.

process.title: From the role to operations.
process.text: A CoWorker is onboarded like a new team member. How long that takes depends on the role and the integrations: some CoWorkers join the team within a few weeks, others take months.
process.label: Animated diagram: the CoWorker passes five stations from the role profile to operations.

steps.name: First conversation and role
steps.text: Together we clarify which tasks the CoWorker takes on in the team, who it reports to and how you measure good work.

steps.name: Access and knowledge
steps.text: Your team defines which systems, storage locations and sources the CoWorker may use. We connect them with least privilege.

steps.name: Development and trial tasks
steps.text: We develop the CoWorker and test it on real tasks from your daily work until the results meet your standard.

steps.name: Onboarding in the team
steps.text: The CoWorker works in the channel your team already uses. At first your team reviews every result, later wherever you define it.

steps.name: Operations and further development
steps.text: utxo AG hosts and monitors the CoWorker, evaluates feedback and extends the role when new tasks come up.
